content: Ekzone ar ekzonor fũza boiyo

Báiboinain okkol, tũwarar butottu hono ekzone zodi guna goredde dora fore, toile tũwara zara Pak Ruhur dehaidiya mozin solo tũwara hitare noromor sãte tuli ano. Kintu nize hušiyar taikko, ar no oile tũwara o dúhat fori zaibagoi.
Tũwara ekzone ar ekzonor fũza boiyo, endilla gori Mosir ainore falon goro.
Honokiye zodi nizore nize kissu no oi bade o kissu oi boli mone gore, hitare hite dúha de.
Hiyan gorattuwaro fotti ekzonottu nizor nizor ham okkolore forikka gora foribo. Toi hitara oinno manušor ham loi nizorgun loi fuwainna no goriyore, nizor ham loi nize borai gori faribo.
Kiyollahoile fotti ekzonottu zar zar fũza tattu bowa foribo.
Ze Allar kalamor babute šike hitattu ustadore hitar hár bala ziniš okkolor bag dón sa.
Tũwara dúhat no foijjo, Allah loi ṭaṭṭa moškari no sole, kiyollahoile ze zin laga, hite hin da.

Hite ze nizor issare furon goribolla zibon haṛa, hite en ekzon aillar ḍoilla ze horaf zobinot sara laga, hite hiyanottu moronor fól faibo. Kintu ze Pak Ruhure razi goitto zibon haṛa, hite Ruhuttu akerotor zibonor fól faibo.
Aiyo ãra bala ham gorattu óran oi no zagoi, kiyollahoile zodi ãra bala ham gorat taki, ṭik ainda aile ãra fošol dai faijjum.
Hetolla ãrattu zetun šuzug ase, aiyo ãra hár manušore balai gori, ar haas gori biššaši foribaror manuš okkolore.
Azomi gora ba no gora
So ãi hottor hottor ḍõr okkor okkol loi ãr nizor hate tũwarar hãse lekir!
Hitara zara tũwarare azomi goraibolla zur gorer, hitara oilde endilla manuš zara battu bala dehaito sar, toi zene hitara Mosir kurušolla zulum fattu basizagoi.
Kiyollahoile zara azomi gore hitara udda Torar ain mozin no sole, tarfore o hitara tũwarare azomi goraito sar, toi zene hitara tũwarare azomi gorabai faijje hoi borai gori fare.
Kintu ãi honodin ãrar Malik Isa Mosir kurušor bade hono kissu loi borai no goijjum. Kiyollahoile he kurušor duwara duniyai ãlla mori giyegoi, ar duniyailla ãi mori giyigoi.
Azomi gora ba no gora hiyan hono kissu no, noya sirišṭi owa oilde asol ziniš.
Hitara zara beggune he noya zibon mozin sole, hitarar uwore, mani Allar he manuš okkolor uwore šanti edde doya takok.
Šešottu hoir, ehonottu loti ar honokiye ãre hošṭo no diyo, kiyollahoile Isalla boli ãr gat dag loi berair.
Báiboinain okkol, ãrar Malik Isa Mosir doya tũwarar fũwati takok. Amen.
